integrity: Exact finite-size identity and limiting law have a full analytic proof; standalone exhaustive checks n=1..8 and separate algebraic integer recurrence through n=150 are provided.
scientific_limitations: Only uniform Dyck words and one balanced insertion pair; source-specific degree formula credited to 2013 prior literature. First moment of the limiting distribution does not exist. Independent external validation not performed.
title: Heavy-tailed insertion-degree deficits in uniform Dyck words
